## 2026-01-30 - Markdown Report Navigation
**Learning:** Long Markdown reports generated by CLI tools become difficult to navigate as data grows. Users are forced to scroll excessively to find specific sections.
**Action:** Always inject a Table of Contents and "Back to Top" links in generated Markdown reports. Use explicit HTML anchors (`<a name='...'></a>`) instead of relying on implicit header slugs, especially when using emojis in headers, to ensure cross-platform compatibility.
